goal: Deliver one fail-closed five-layer test gate with honest governed coverage and repeatable installed-package smoke.

batches.name: framework-core
batches.gate: unit layer passes; intentional assertion returns non-zero

batches.name: five-layer-corrections
batches.gate: unit, contract, integration and Electron layers pass independently

batches.name: honest-coverage
batches.gate: governed lines >=80%; security branches >=90%; omitted file counts as zero

batches.name: fault-gate-selftest
batches.gate: each injected child fails non-zero; unexpected zero fails self-test

batches.name: stability
changes: verify formal artifacts and Temp cleanup after each run

batches.name: formal-package
batches.gate: new Build ID; packaged restart and uninstall pass; all five layers/coverage/self-test pass

explicitNonGoals: No CI workflow, lint, SCA, secret scan, signing, or artifact upload (GOV-04/REL tasks)
No claim of whole-product coverage until the governed registry includes the whole product
No Playwright/Jest/Vitest or external browser-driver stack
